requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-3734-4231-4875--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2793-3743-5089-6753-8242.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-6753-8242.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Songbird by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

4279-4314-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4316-4359-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

34-147-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-5231.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1854-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-4050.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3234-3293-6620.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
728-3234-3293-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat
728-3234-3293-6620.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

6351-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

372-1567-2781.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1567-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

2723-3046.description:
Deal damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
Overgrown Armasaur and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Overgrown Armasaur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
Repeat from step 2.

1017-1494-5436-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-5231-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5231-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5189-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2363-5660-6872.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5686-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5686-6255-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1020-3689-4668-6518.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1020-3689-4668-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3682-4518-5542-7183.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {U}.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4766-5231-6990.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

997-3090-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1174-1479-6517.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-6517.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

38-659-5200.easyPrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
38-659-5200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
38-659-5200.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
38-659-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2452-3249-4268-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3908-4772-5403.description:
Cast Oko by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Oko, and to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate an Oko's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, causing you to create two token copies of each other nonland permanent you control.
If you created any legenedary tokens this way, put all but one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3 using a different Oko.
Once you have infinite Oko tokens, you may instead activate Oko's other abilities.

1283-2034-3578.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificng Chronosavant, adding {2}.
Activate Chronosavant by paying {2}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to skip your next turn.
Repeat.

803-2534-3126.notablePrerequisites:
Marrow-Gnawer does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You control at least one additional Rat.
803-2534-3126.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat, creating at least one 1/1 Rat creature token.
When the Rat enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Marrow-Gnawer.
Repeat.
If you control at least two other Rats, this combo creates infinite additional Coercive Recruiter triggers, which can be used to untap any creature(s) infinitely and/or to gain control of any number of creature(s) until end of turn.

2076-3101-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hazoret's Monument trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

849-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
